[SWS_DM_00350] Confirmation of UDS message transmission
⌈
When
the Uds Transport Protocol implementation has a final feedback of the network
layer, whether the UDS message triggered for transmission (see [SWS_DM_00348])
could be sent on the network or not, it shall notify DM by calling TransmitConfir-
mation ([SWS_DM_00312]) on its UdsTransportProtocolMgr reference ((see
[SWS_DM_00330]) setting the message argument to the message parameter of the
Transmit call ([SWS_DM_00348]).
⌋
